title: lathyrus latifolius subsp. algericus
intro: Lathyrus latifolius subsp. algericus, commonly known as Algerian peashrub, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus latifolius subsp. algericus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful for treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
